extract_qkv_single_head: extract Q, K, and V matrices for a single attention head from a given transformer layer
extract_qkv_all_heads: extract Q, K, and V matrices for all attention heads as lists from a given layer
get_matrices_for_layer: get the query, key, and value projection matrices for a specific transformer layer number
reshape_qkv_to_2d: reshape Q, K, V projections from 4D batched tensors into 2D sequence-by-embedding matrices
broadcast_kv_to_heads: broadcast single K and V projections across all attention heads for multi-head analysis
